nonblocking_findings.title: definition_context_changed uses observer-TU read-set union
nonblocking_findings.detail: A symbol defined in a TU that does not read a changed header can receive a context event when another observing/calling TU does read it. In V2, audit_remote_value is defined in third.cpp (does not read settings.hpp) but its units include main.cpp, which does; changed_inputs only lists the actual settings.hpp path. README/API/envelope document observer-TU scope and 'possible input-context change, not runtime behavior'. No false path is inserted into changed_inputs.

nonblocking_findings.title: same-definition-file external constant may be file-only
nonblocking_findings.detail: In edge-constexpr.dI5Hgx, changing same-file external_value 1->2 yields diff-symbols total_count=0 and only a main.cpp file_text_changed with before SHA 9ed4c8d98efc67e52289d5da2307346fe75beaa300a0c665950ee2ec01abedb1 and after SHA 015a9aa8ffae057092716ab3a05dc1c8a5e07207bc404e55c49334eafbdd7691. This follows from excluding definition/primary source buffers to keep pure line moves/body edits stable. README/API/envelope explicitly document that same-buffer external constants may only appear as file/source deltas and do not prove behavioral equivalence. The file-level before/after evidence is retained; no false 'unchanged' claim is made.

nonblocking_findings.title: UI post-POST terminal race is theoretical
nonblocking_findings.detail: post() does not immediately update available; current refresh POST returns nonterminal and the real delayed-refresh Playwright test observed disabled compare throughout. Not observed and not a mandatory failure.

limitations.description: definition_context_changed uses observer-TU positive read-set union; a symbol whose own definition TU does not read a changed header can be reported if another observing TU reads it. changed_inputs lists only actual read paths; docs/envelope explicitly label this conservative and possible-only.

Same-definition-file external constexpr/constant changes can produce only file_text_changed/source delta, not a symbol-level definition_context_changed. This is documented as a boundary and does not prove behavioral equivalence; file-level before/after hashes remain visible. Excluding definition/primary buffers is required to keep pure line moves and body edits stable.
Theoretical post-POST terminal refresh race in WorkspacePanel was not observed; current refresh POST returns nonterminal and the real delayed-refresh test kept compare disabled throughout.

The entire historical 84-file matrix was not reconstructed. Current full gate, current 136 backend tests, 9 Chromium tests, targeted V2-V9 fixtures, and byte-unchanged-path review were used; user explicitly allowed concentration on existing evidence and prohibited reopening the huge old matrix.
A bare lone-CR fixture versus Clang line numbering was not separately constructed. CRLF, U+0085, Chinese, emoji, combining and invalid-byte windows were tested; no observed failure.
docs/http-api.md contains the minor typo 'at most8' (missing space); no protocol/identity/security effect.
M2-B cache reuse/acceleration and mandatory case 21 are out of scope by user instruction; no PASS is claimed for them.

Only self-owned fixtures and fake private sentinels were used; no RMC/F11/reference implementation/real private project/credentials/sensitive material was used. The authorized api.deepseek.com transmission of review-2 material did occur; no claim is made that no data was sent.

final_note: ACCEPT is limited to the independently verified M2-A scope 01-20 plus 22. The prior 1800-second timeout was not an ACCEPT; no native verdict existed before this report completion. N1 and N2 are real disclosed limitations, not hidden failures, and are nonblocking under the current documented M2-A contract.
